tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ldan lha mo'i zhal hom gyi las bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rnam thar sgor gzhol rgyal ba'i yum// tshad med bzhis bskul las kyi ma// dud sol zhes bya sa gsum na// dbang mo che la phyag 'tshal lo// me lce 'phreng ba las gsungs pa'i dpal lha mo nag mo'i zhal hom bcas te dgra bgegs sgrol bar 'dod pas/ dus gza' drag po rgyu ba/ phung gsum bdud kyi nyi ma la/ sa me thub bzang po la lcags phye/ dur khrod kyi sa rdo/ ngam grogamatsho/ g.yul sprad pa'i sa la klu gdol pa gnas pa'i chu mig gi chus sbrus la las kyi ma mo gshin rje mo'i gzugs shin tu khros pa/ ljags brkyang ba/ rgyan med ral pa spyi bor bcing pa/ lag g.yas nyi ma/ g.yon zla ba rdeb la khad pa'i phyar stabs/ gru gsum gyi nang nas lto ba yan 'phags pa/ nang khong seng zhal spyan kun nas me lhab lhab yong ba la/ mgar gyi sol ba dang dug khrag ro sol gyis nag por byug dug shing gi lo ma la dug khrag gis dgra ling*/ tha ma la bsad sngags kyis bskor ba brgya rtsa brgyad rang gi dri ma ma shor ba bri/ bong bu nag po'i chu la dgra'i zag rdzas ji snyed pa sbangs te byugs zhun chen nag gi mar khu cung zad dang*/ gru gsum du seng ldeng*/ med na gla ba/ tsher nag skyer ba gsum gyi shing bu brtsigs la gshan pa'am mgar ba'i khyim nas me blangs la des sbar/ las sbyor gyi sngon du lidga rtags thon bsgrubs yod na bzang*/ med na bdag nyid gshin rje gshed lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa shin tu khro ba dmigs/ thugs ka nas pho nya bzhi spros/ de rnams kyis dmigs pa'i dgra dngos dang de'i srung zlog mkhan rnams kyi snying phug zhags pas bcings te khur nas mdun gyi nya'u rnams la bstim/ bden bdar tshar gsum bya/ de nas dgug pa'i sngags 'di bzlas so// oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bhyo/ ma ma trag rakṣa ru lu ru lu bhyo dza dza khug ā kakṣa ya dza bzlas/ de nas gu gul gyi dud pa la ling ga bdug

bya rog 'ug pa'i sgros brdeg cing*/ ma ma trag rakṣa ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo dza dgra bo mā ra ya phye phye/ ma ma ru ti ni a phye zhes pas de lha dang bral bar bsam/ de nas lcags phye zangs phye rdo phye yungs kar nag sogs kyi thun mtshon char dmigs nas/ ma bhyo ma ma ru la ru lu trag rakṣa bhyo re ma ti dgra bo mā ra ya dza hūm̐ bhyo badzra phaṭ ces brabs pas gnod byed brgyal 'bogs par bsam/ de nas sku gzugs kyi mtha' la drag po'i mchod pa bdun bkod/ rang nyid bdud chas su zhugs/ skad cig gis gshin rje gshed mthing nag g.yas tho ba 'phyar zhing g.yon skam pa bzung ba rgyan med gcer bu shin tu 'jigs pa'i skur gyur/ de nas mdun du sku gzugs de swa bhā was stong pa nyid du gyur/ de'i ngang las dug khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar nag tu 'khyil ba'i nang na mi ro rta ro lang long du yod pa/ las kyi rlung dmar gyis bsgul ba/ khrag zhal gi wu ba ri tsam du 'phyo ba/ 'ur sgra dang thug chom stong gsum du grags pa/ nad kyi rlangs pas nam mkha' gang ba/ mtshon cha'i zil pa ser drag tu 'bab pa/ keng rus kyi gram pas mtha' bskor ba de'i nang du las kyi ma mo mthing nag sku ri rab kyi bongs tsam ral pa spyi bor bcings shing phyed grol ba/ lag pa gnyis kyis nyi zla'i cha lang rdeb pas byad ma dgra bgegs thams cad nur nur bcur ba zhal gdangs shing ljags brkyang ba'i nang nas bskal pa'i me lce lhab lhab 'bar ba/ mig gsum khro chu khol ma ltar khol ba/ ba spu'i gseb nas nad kyi khro chu'i tsha tsha dmar sil li li khol ba/ skar chen thog gi bu yug tshub pa/ sna nas rims kyis dud pa 'thul ba/ lte ba dkar po lha'i dmag gi rdzong*/ srid pa'i khyams khang ste/ de na dpal mgon lcam dral las byed sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad 'jigs pa gshin rje'i gzugs mthong na skyi bung ba/ sha la rngam shing khrag la dung ba thams cad tshogs pa/

lte ba man dug khrag gi rgya mtshor bying ba sku stod me dang du ba 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐ phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na// nyi ma byang shar pha gi na// brag dang chu 'thab mtshams shed na// stong gsum stong gi rgya mnyam pa'i// dug mtsho mu le ding chen po// khrag gi rba klong 'khrug pa nas// sku phyed thon pa mun pa'i mdog /las kyi ma mo ma rungs pa// dmar nag khrag gi ral pa can// lte ba srid pa'i khyams khang ste// dkar po lha yi dmag dpung tshogs// zhal gdangs ljags brkyang mche ba gtsigs// zhal nas bskal pa'i me lce 'bar// lus las nad kyi tsha tsha 'phro// sna nas rims kyi dud pa 'thul// phyag gnyis nyi zla'i cha lang rdeb// pha rol rig sngags bzlog bsgyur mdzad// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// da tshur byon la dgra bgegs sgrol// oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi kā li kā li mahā kā li hūm̐ bhyo e ar li hriṃ dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki? ni sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ ṣya hoṃ/ de byon nas bskyed pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pa la/ khrag chen gyi arghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bkru/ dbang po'i me tog gsur chen gyi bdud spos/ klad chen gyi byug pa/ rkang gling gi rol mo/ zhun chen gyi mar me phul/ lcags sam zangs sam thod snod du gtor ma snying snas brgyan pa dang*/ khrag sna dza gad bshams nas bsngo/ de nas til mar mas bstod cing bskul 'di btang*/ hūm̐ nag mo khrag 'thung kun gyi rje// khams gsum dbang sdud gdug pa can// khyod kyi thugs dam ngas bskul gyi// dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes nas// chad pa'i yas 'gam da dngos la// bcol ba'i las 'di sgrub par mdzod// ma rung dgra bgegs mi bsgral na// ma mo khyod kyi thugs dam g.yel// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag /rnal 'byor bdag gi re ba chad// khyod kyang nyams pa'i me yis sreg /de na dam las mi 'da' zhing*// snyoms g.yel le lo mi mdzad par// do nub sang nub tshun chad la// dmigs pa'i dgra 'di bsgral du gsol// 'dis ni dkon mchog gsum po smad// chos skyong srung ma gnyan la bsdos// sems can yongs kyi bde skyid bcom// rnal 'byor bdag la mthu med zer// shi srog dmar po 'ben du btsugs// nga yi mgon skyabs khyed lags kyi// khyod kyis mthu dang rtsal phyung la// sdig can 'khor bcas bsgral du gsol// srid pa gsum gyi dbang po che// mthu dang rtsal gyis dregs pa kun// ma mo khyod kyi bka' mi 'gong*// de dag dang bcas der byon la// de yi srog rngubs rngam zas kyis// sha zo khrag 'thung rus pa mur// gnyen 'dun nor rdzas brlag tu chug

/yul 'khar lo tog 'joms su gsol// de nas me sbar me lce kha nas lhab byung ba dang*/ lidga skam pas blangs tho bas brdungs te/ dug snum la sbangs te zhal du/ ma bhyo ma ma ru lu trag rakṣa bhyo re ma ti dgra bo sarba sha trūm̐ mā ra ya dza hūm̐ bhyo badzra phaṭ ces ling ga re dang sngags re bstun la brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ de'i dbus su lha mo'i zhal du gsol bas lto ba'i nang du sleb pa dang*/ nang gi dmag tshogs kyi hab thob tu rub ste zos par bsam/ sngags re la thal mo rdeb/ las kyi ma mo khyed la dgra bgegs che ge mo 'di zas skal du gtad pas 'di'i srog rtsa chod/ dbang po gtubs/ snying longs/ dbugs 'goms/ sha zo/ khrag 'thung*/ klad pa 'jibs/ dwangs ma rngubs/ rus pa mur/ lpags pa bgos/ rang shed rang la phob cig rang bdud rang la phob/ mi tshe ring po la dus ma 'debs/ nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ skye shi la khungs ma phyung*/ las dang las kyi rnam par smin pa la snyad ma 'dogs/ da lta nyid du rtags phyung mtshan ma ston/ gzugs phung bshig yid dpung 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol zer zhing rdzogs par phul/ zin pa dang bsad sngags nyer gcig bzlas/ sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor bcas kyi bden pa dang*/ las kyi sbyor ba 'di'i stobs kyis rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ gdug pa'i bsam ngan bcangs pa/ drag shul gyi sbyor ba rtsub par ston pa thams cad kho rang la sgyur cig zlog cing*/ rlag par gyur cig zhag bdun nam lngar nyi ma dmar thag chod pa tsam la bya/ bskul btang*/ thal ba dang gtor ma bzhes pa phul/ de nas ma mo'i lte ba'i dmag tshogs thon nas 'khor bcas dgra yul du song nas kho 'khor bcas thal ba rdul du rlog par bsam/ zor du 'phang*/ thal mo rdeb/ las sngags smeng*/ nang du log bsrung 'khor bsgom/
sku 'gol sar sba/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// sarba madga laṃ/// /
